formula: Measured C, M, P=draft-prefill. Hypothetical Cnew=C-f*P+h; strict gain iff f>(C-M+h)/P. f in [0,1] includes actually reusable fraction, realized hit rate and realized speedup; h is total additional synchronization/maintenance/allocation overhead. Not causal prediction.
alternative_formula: For identical-state n-use sharing only, ideal Cnew=C-P+P/n+h; strict gain iff n>P/(P-(C-M)-h), with positive denominator. Model does not establish cache validity, natural hit rates, or avoided work.
coverage: Days1/2 only (2026-10-31/2026-11-01); two sessions each; each model12fixed previously exposed inputs. Repeated inputs/sessions not independent date populations.
